title: Bold and Brash
description: A simple mod that adds some of Squidward's paintings to Minecraft
body:
This mod turns some of Squidward's paintings (including an original by [@TikkiToon](https://bsky.app/profile/tikkitoon.bsky.social)!) into pixel art and adds them to Minecraft as painting variants.

![Bold and Brash displayed in an art museum](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8qUcSBPS/images/f4961b34d43e4f302900890e5890d281b7aa184c.png)

Being a very prolific painter, Mr. Squidward has inspired countless young talents to follow in his footsteps; I have therefore included in this collection a classic Squidwardian work by [@TikkiToon](https://bsky.app/profile/tikkitoon.bsky.social) (original [here](https://www.newgrounds.com/art/view/tikkitoon/squidward-art)):

(If you really like the painting consider also donating to TikkiToon on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/tikkitoon))

!["Squbism 2" - painting based on TikkiToon's original work](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8qUcSBPS/images/5b4606b14a4e5b84bdff48199814a10dae9c784a.png)
